scripts.build: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/sdk && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p worker
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run format:check
scripts.dev: bun run build && bun run --cwd worker dev
